investigation_notes.Description: The PowerShell script block on DC-EAST-01 appears to enumerate Active Directory domain policies using commands like Get-ADDomainController, Get-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy, and Get-ADFineGrainedPasswordPolicy. This pattern matches routine administrative or automated compliance checks rather than a malicious payload, and no external network activity or suspicious file/download behavior is observed within the script. Historical context shows a similar alert (SOC-2105) with the same script structure that was previously closed as a false positive, supporting the likelihood of legitimate activity. Given the absence of corroborating indicators of compromise and the user being SYSTEM on a domain controller, the alert is classified as Low Priority (LP).
